sources.publisher: Occidental / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
sources.title: 2016 first-quarter Form 10-Q, Part II Item 5: CEO appointment
sources.findings: Read Part II Item 5: CEO appointment on 29 April 2016 and employment with Occidental since 1982. The quarter ended 31 March but this subsequent event was included in the filing signed 5 May. Age 56 is not converted into an exact birth year.

sources.title: 9 March 2020: UA Salutes Female Trailblazers, Part 2
sources.findings: University confirms the 1981 mineral engineering bachelor’s degree and the first female CEO of a major U.S. oil and gas company in April 2016. Its shorthand saying Occidental employment since 1981 is corrected using the regulatory filing and Senate testimony.

sources.publisher: U.S. Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources
sources.title: 27 April 2021: testimony of Vicki Hollub
sources.findings: Read her 27 April 2021 Senate testimony: engineering career began at Cities Service in 1981. Carbon capture proposals and net-zero dates are her corporate policy positions and ambitions, not verified emissions reductions.

sources.publisher: Occidental / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
sources.title: 2017 proxy statement: director biography and executive succession
sources.findings: Read the 2017 proxy biography: president and COO from December 2015 to April 2016; board member from December 2015. Historical international roles are not treated as current postings. Adjacent directors’ degrees and biographies are excluded.

sources.publisher: Occidental / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
sources.title: 8 August 2019: completion of Anadarko acquisition
sources.findings: Read completion release: Anadarko acquisition closed on 8 August 2019; US$55 billion value includes assumed debt. Expected synergies are not reported as achieved returns or personal investment.

sources.title: November 2023: Occidental acquisition of Carbon Engineering
sources.findings: Read BLG deal report: completion announced on 3 November 2023; an Occidental subsidiary acquired Carbon Engineering for about US$1.1 billion cash paid in installments. BLG represented the buyer’s subsidiary, so its climate-benefit language is not independent efficacy verification.

sources.title: 1 August 2024: completion of CrownRock acquisition
sources.findings: Read official closing release dated 1 August 2024. CrownRock purchase is a corporate transaction during Hollub’s tenure, not her personal acquisition. Promotional portfolio and emissions claims are not independently adopted.

sources.publisher: Occidental / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
sources.title: 1 May 2026: CEO succession effective 1 June
sources.findings: Read 1 May 2026 succession announcement. Retirement became effective 1 June, with Richard Jackson succeeding as president and CEO and Hollub remaining a director. The announcement and effective dates are distinguished.

sources.title: 1 May 2026: Hollub to hand CEO role to Richard Jackson
sources.findings: Read Reuters report dated 1 May 2026, including discussion of Anadarko-related debt, asset sales and investor scrutiny. It supports balanced financial context, not a finding of illegality or a particular investor’s unverified allegation.

sources.title: Energy Advisory Council: Vicki Hollub biography
sources.findings: Read Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas biography confirming retirement in June 2026 and historical technical and management roles in the United States, Russia, Venezuela and Ecuador. Current external affiliations are not all added without separate verification.

sources.title: 29 September 2026: Hollub Form 4, director status and reported transaction
sources.findings: Read SEC Form 4 identifying Hollub as a director and reporting a 25 September 2026 transaction. Signed on 29 September by Brittany A. Smith as attorney-in-fact, not personally by Hollub. This is indirect evidence of recent activity and board status; personal family-asset details are not reproduced in the public biography.
